svg.title: Davids Platform — .NET 10 Microservices, Infrastructure, Repository Relationships and Security Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing all eight standalone .NET 10 Davids repositories, Clean Architecture project layers, Dual-Authority OpenIddict RS256 OIDC PKCE and YARP Admin/Customer BFF flows, Workforce RBAC, Transactional Change Audits, physically isolated SQL Server databases, Redis, RabbitMQ, HashiCorp Vault KV-v2 bootstrap, Prometheus/Jaeger/Grafana/Seq observability, Istio STRICT mTLS service mesh, and the five lifecycle security verification stages.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
